newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen steady on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen steady on blue chips.

text.p: Jakarta stocks were seen remaining steady on Wednesday on expected active buying in tobacco and cement sectors, brokers said.
"Blue chips, particularly in the tobacco and cement sectors, are likely to continue driving the market up as the sectors are considered to remain undervalued," one broker said.

Brokers said said the cement and tobacco sectors had come under strong selling pressure due to fears of slow growth, but the fears appeared to be overdone and that players began to hunt for bargains in the past few days.
Brokers, however, said the brief sharp falls in the rupiah in early Wednesday trading was seen capping any possible sharp upside.

The rupiah nose-dived to a low of 2,445.0 against the dollar in early trade on Wednesday following the flotation of the Thai baht, but it recovered very quickly to its opening level around 2,433.0/35.0.
The Jakarta composite index closed at 731.62 points on Tuesday, up 0.97 percent.
